metadata.name: solception
metadata.description: Solception - a launchpad that launches launchpads on Solana

accounts.name: authority
docs: Must be the program's upgrade authority, so nobody can front-run init.

accounts.name: mint
docs: Fresh keypair from the client (lets you grind vanity "...pad" addresses).

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Signer is not authorized for this action

errors.name: InvalidBps
errors.msg: Basis points value out of range

errors.name: TradeFeeTooHigh
errors.msg: Trade fee exceeds the platform maximum

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: CurveComplete
errors.msg: Bonding curve has completed; trade on the DEX

errors.name: CurveNotComplete
errors.msg: Bonding curve has not completed yet

errors.name: InsufficientSolReserves
errors.msg: Not enough SOL in the curve

errors.name: WrongFeeRecipient
errors.msg: Recipient does not match the fee bucket

types.name: BondingCurve
docs: Layer 2 — a token's bonding curve. Holds the raised SOL and accrued fees.

fields.name: platform_fees_accrued
docs: Fees are accrued here per trade (no global write-lock), then claimed.

types.name: CurveConfig
docs: Curve economics a launchpad applies to every token it launches.

fields.name: initial_virtual_sol
docs: Starting virtual SOL reserve (lamports).

fields.name: initial_virtual_tokens
docs: Starting virtual token reserve (base units).

fields.name: curve_token_supply
docs: Tokens sold through the curve. Curve completes when all are sold.

fields.name: lp_token_reserve
docs: Tokens held back to pair with raised SOL on the DEX after graduation.

fields.name: uri
docs: Metaplex JSON (image, description, socials).

types.name: Launchpad
docs: Layer 1 — a launchpad created through Solception.

fields.name: fee_recipient
docs: Where the launchpad's share of fees is claimed to.

fields.name: uri
docs: Off-chain branding JSON (logo, colors, domain, socials).

fields.name: trade_fee_bps
docs: Total fee on each buy/sell.

fields.name: creator_fee_share_bps
docs: Share of the post-platform fee that goes to the token creator.

fields.name: token_launch_fee
docs: Lamports charged to launch a token on this pad.

types.name: Platform
docs: Layer 0 — the Solception platform itself (singleton).

fields.name: treasury
docs: Receives launchpad creation fees and claimed platform trade/launch fees.

fields.name: migration_authority
docs: Wallet allowed to pull graduated liquidity to seed the DEX pool.

fields.name: launchpad_creation_fee
docs: Lamports paid to the treasury to create a launchpad.

fields.name: platform_fee_share_bps
docs: Platform's cut of every fee generated by every launchpad.

fields.name: max_trade_fee_bps
docs: Max trade fee a launchpad may charge.

fields.name: sol_amount
docs: Net SOL that moved in/out of the curve reserves (excl. fee).

fields.name: curve
docs: Applies to tokens launched after the update only.
